name: Investigación Filosófica AI-assisted silver judge v1

policy.relevance: The NLI label is the silver relevance judgment. The reranker is an independent retrieval signal used for disagreement detection, not a forced relevance label.
policy.discipline: NLI zero-shot classification into non-philosophical, interdisciplinary, or philosophical.
policy.role: NLI zero-shot classification into documentary roles; low-confidence role predictions are converted to UNSURE.
policy.humanReview: Flag low-confidence cases, missing abstracts, role uncertainty, or strong disagreement between NLI relevance and within-query reranker percentile bucket.
